hero.description: I am a Software Engineer specializing in Backend architecture, asynchronous systems, and AI integration. I don't just write code; I focus on turning ideas into stable, cost-optimized products ready for real-world operations.

about.title: About Me
about.para1: My journey started with AI research and competitive programming training (OLP/ICPC), where I built a strong habit of reasoning under tight constraints. As I moved into Software Engineering, I positioned myself as a Product Engineer — responsible for the entire product lifecycle from architectural design to end-user experience.
about.para2: I am strongest when working on systems that need clear boundaries, resilient asynchronous processing, and smart trade-off decisions. I believe great software isn't just about running correctly; it must be observable, scalable, and highly optimized for operational resources.
about.skills_intro: Here are a few technologies and practices I have been working with recently:

points: Led full-stack development across multiple production systems: backend APIs (FastAPI, NestJS), real-time workflows, and consumer-facing interfaces (React, Tailwind CSS).
Designed and implemented asynchronous processing systems with reliable message queuing, worker pools, and exponential backoff for fault recovery.

Specialized in cost optimization: reduced Firestore operational costs by 90% through intelligent client-side caching (IndexedDB), and optimized cloud message queue handling to bypass provider payload limitations.
Built and deployed a commercial self-ordering platform for restaurants from zero to production, currently serving 2 pilot coffee shops with 1 live for over a month.
Established end-to-end CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions for automated linting, testing, and deployment; integrated Telegram Bot API for real-time order notifications.
Implemented secure payment integration (VietQR), multi-language support, and merchant admin dashboard for menu/pricing management.
Trained with the OLP/ICPC programming team, strengthening algorithmic thinking, problem decomposition, and debugging under time pressure.
Received the 'Excellent Research Project' recognition in the faculty-level student research competition.
Served as a teaching assistant for fundamental programming courses for four semesters, helping students build strong logical foundations.

featured.name: Audio Processing & API Service (Confidential)
visual_details: Designed stakeholder-facing web demo for early feedback and client validation.
Built backend endpoints for audio intake, processing, and result delivery.
Implemented multi-format audio validation (MP3, WAV, frequency detection) with clear error messaging.
Orchestrated audio signal processing workflows with recovery mechanisms for production stability.
Delivered results back to client with proper streaming and state management.
desc: Co-designed a 3-version technical roadmap (MVP → Full-featured) with the CEO to balance speed and completeness.
Built backend APIs and documented integration contracts for mobile client adoption.
Diagnosed and resolved critical launch-phase issues: cross-browser compatibility (Safari/Chrome), multi-format validation, and production stability.
Engineered robust audio processing with fallback strategies and keep-alive mechanisms to ensure reliable operation during peak usage.

featured.name: Document Processing & Real-Time Gateway (Confidential)
visual_details: Built task submission interface with progress state management.
Designed request validation and job metadata creation for background processing.
Queued work for asynchronous processing to keep main API responsive.
Managed distributed task execution with health monitoring and recovery.
Streamed processing status back to clients through real-time channels.
desc: Architected an asynchronous document processing pipeline with background workers to prevent API blocking on long-running tasks.
Optimized cloud messaging by bypassing payload limits: passed reference IDs and SAS URLs instead of full file streams, reducing network overhead.
Implemented proactive worker recovery with periodic health checks and automatic task requeue, improving system reliability and reducing stuck-task incidents.
Built a real-time progress gateway using WebSockets, allowing clients to follow processing status and improving overall system responsiveness.

featured.name: QR Menu Generator Platform (Production)
visual_details: Implemented responsive digital menu interface with core ordering flows.
Built merchant admin dashboard for content management, pricing, and menu configuration.
Integrated VietQR payment processing for the complete order lifecycle.
Connected Telegram Bot API for real-time order notifications and staff confirmations.
Established CI/CD pipeline with automated testing and deployment.
desc: Developed and deployed a commercial self-ordering platform from scratch; currently live at 2 pilot coffee shops with 1 operating for over a month in production.
Implemented bi-directional Telegram Bot integration, enabling staff to receive and confirm/cancel orders directly from chat without a web dashboard.
Reduced Firestore operational costs by 90% through intelligent client-side caching (IndexedDB) and query optimization for repeat customers.
Established end-to-end CI/CD using GitHub Actions for linting, testing, and automated deployment with zero-downtime updates.

list.name: Digital Menu System & E-Commerce Integration
list.desc: Core digital menu platform with product variant management, pricing, category hierarchy, and merchant analytics dashboard. Migrated from NoSQL to relational SQL architecture.

list.name: Smart Home Monitoring & Control System (IoT)
list.desc: Real-time web dashboard for controlling and monitoring home IoT devices. Supports tracking temperature, humidity, lighting, and appliance statuses via WebSocket and MQTT protocols, featuring interactive data visualization.

list.name: Document Information Extraction (Research)
list.desc: Computer vision pipeline for Vietnamese ID card (CCCD) extraction: YOLO object detection for card alignment, VietOCR for text recognition, and Flask dashboard for results presentation.
